# coprod

> coprod (coprod llc, Switzerland) builds a unified robotics stack: modular
> hardware — co:power, co:battery, co:motion, co:sensor — on one real-time
> EtherCAT bus (1 kHz typical, jitter < 20 us), controlled through one API
> (C++ core, Python bindings). Tagline: Making Hardware Simple.

co:dodo is our bipedal robot built on the stack. You can drive its actual
trained policies in the browser at https://coprod.co/simulator/ — MuJoCo
compiled to WebAssembly stepping real physics, ONNX inference at 50 Hz,
no install and no backend.

## Pages

- [Products](https://coprod.co/products): co:power (modular power, 10-54.6 V),
  co:battery (packs with telemetry), co:motion (motion controllers),
  co:sensor (dual-redundant IMU, 30 x 50 mm).
- [Systems](https://coprod.co/systems): co:dodo and what the stack builds.
- [Jobs](https://coprod.co/jobs): open core-hardware roles in Switzerland;
  interns and master thesis welcome. Open applications: contact@coprod.ch.
- [Values](https://coprod.co/values): read before applying.
- [Community](https://coprod.co/community): the co:builders Discord, the
  ambassador programme for campuses and labs, and our channels.

Discord: https://coprod.co/discord
Contact: contact@coprod.ch · GitHub: https://github.com/coprod-llc
